_comment: Canonical reference trajectory, extracted verbatim from qmini_leg_env.py's MotionPlayer keyframes (the training source of truth). Joint order is [hip, knee, ankle], values in degrees, time in seconds. Load this same file from robot_deploy.py's MotionReference and from tune_pid_isaaclab.py instead of hand-typing separate copies -- see the note below about a sign mismatch found between qmini_leg_env.py and robot_deploy.py's current hardcoded copies.
_warning: robot_deploy.py's DEFAULT_KEYFRAMES_DEG currently reads [20,-50,30] at t=0, while qmini_leg_env.py's MotionPlayer reads [-20,50,30] at t=0 -- i.e. hip/knee are sign-flipped between the two. This may be intentional (matching the 'invert' flags in robot_config.json: hip invert=true, knee/ankle invert=false), but it's exactly the kind of mismatch that silently breaks sim-to-real trajectory comparisons. Verify which convention is correct for your MotionPlayer before trusting either sim or real logs, then delete the losing copy and load this file from both places.
